subject: Auditing and Ethics
question_text:
7.  
As per SA 560, when, after the date of the auditor’s report but before 
the date the financial statements are issued, a fact becomes known to 
the auditor that, had it been known at the date of the auditor’s report, 
may have caused the auditor to amend the auditor’s report, the auditor 
shall: 
(a)  
Modify the opinion in accordance with SA 705 and provide the 
amended auditor’s report. 
(b)  
Discuss the matter with management and determine whether the 
financial statements need amendment. 
(c)  
Notify shareholders directly to prevent reliance on the auditor’s 
report. 
(d)  
Withdraw from the engagement and disclaim an opinion.
